text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Early morning on the day of the Oka Sho—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Ruby?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry.
Did I wake you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine.
More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I was thinking of going for a jog.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You have a race today, right?
Isn't it a bit early to warm up?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I ended up waking up.
Moving my body around is actually more relaxing for me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hey, could it be—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...No,
it's nothing."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... you'll be just fine.
I'm rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(...Right. I am...
I am part of the "Illustrious Family"—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fitting for a Classic race, Hanshin Racecourse
was packed with huge crowds. Among them—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin, Palmer-chin!
I found the young lady's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer is an Umamusume of the prestigious Mejiro family and from the same generation. Apparently, she came to watch the race today after being dragged along by Daitaku Helios.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Man, the hype is insane! Everyone was talking about Ruby on the way here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, when you say "The Illustrious Family"...
I imagine even people with no interest in racing
are turning up to watch.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey,
think I could actually go for a run right now after all!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run with Ojooo~~!!
Gotta go ask her right now!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Helios, wait!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then Trainer-san,
we...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—The "Illustrious Clan" really is
something else!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby's mother ran away with the lead
at this Oka Sho with incredible speed.
I'm sure she's going to be just as amazing.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
There's no way she'll lose!
I know Daiichi Ruby will carry on
the spirit of that day's run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...So passionate~.
Are they a longtime fan, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: “But what if you still lose? You have the perfect pedigree and plenty of talent, right?”

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with her.
If she loses... that's on the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
choice_data_list: It's okay, it's the truth after all

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is naturally gifted and a hard worker to boot.
If she fails to win, it's only natural that my training methods would be called into question.
choice_data_list: (That's also something a trainer has to shoulder.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bracing myself, I returned to the waiting room,
where Daiichi Ruby was waiting motionless, just as she always did.
choice_data_list: Those are some amazing flowers, as always.
Those are some amazing flowers, as always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While nobody barges in directly like they used to,
no matter how many arrangements are made, the flowers sent to her never stop coming.
If anything, they've only increased to the point of burying the room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, I suddenly realized. She was always so dignified,
but today she seemed somewhat tense...
as if she were pushed right to her limit.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, there's no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Today is an important day that will test my true worth—
whether I can carry on our family's glorious legacy.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: A few mental ups and downs are well within my expectations. Therefore, it is no problem at all.

Before the debut race, when I asked if she was nervous
just like I did just now, she seemed genuinely fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... right now, it almost looks
as though she's trying to convince herself
that everything is fine.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I shall be on my way.
Well then—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I can help. But...
I wanted her to realize it was the truth by telling her how others saw her.
choice_data_list: Believe in what lies within you.
Believe in what lies within you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: The blood of the “illustrious family” flows through you
The blood of the “illustrious family” flows through you

text_block_list.text: For her, that should be something to believe in... something that brings more confidence than any words ever could.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I shall be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(It is not just those present here today.
Every single eye tied to the history of the
'Illustrious Lineage' is watching me.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(I can run. Coursing through my veins...
is blood to be proud of.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —...The time to blossom is now.
